title: Al-Rajhi Issues Circular Mandating Application of Universal Access Guidelines Standards
summary: Heads of the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources, Social Development and Housing issued a circular requiring the application of universal access guidelines and standards. This directive mandates that facilities and services comply with accessibility requirements to ensure equal access for individuals with disabilities.
body:
Heads of the Saudi Ministry of Human Resources, Social Development and Housing issued a circular requiring the application of universal access guidelines and standards. This directive mandates that facilities and services comply with accessibility requirements to ensure equal access for individuals with disabilities.
